next_order_id returns 'o' + 6-digit padded (max o<digits> id + 1). Scans all pages via list_page cursor, not iter_records (first page only). Not reserved: concurrent callers can collide.
_ORDER_ID = o([0-9]+) parses the sequence; non-matching ids (e.g. 'legacy-id') are ignored, not errors. Padding breaks id-order past o999999.
Known bug left alone: iter_records reads only the first page, so Repository.orders() drops orders past max_page_size (100). Do not rely on iter_records for full listings.
